bibliographic.title: Gamer: Digital Limbo
bibliographic.author: Ian Ross
bibliographic.description: You wake up from a strange dream you barely remember to find yourself sitting on your couch in your living room.  The blinds are closed. Your TV against the north wall is off and the lack of light makes it hard to see.  There is a strange looking videogame controller on the coffee table in front of you, next to a small white envelope. Where did that come from?
